finite_normal_ray_diagnostic.method: pure 2D meridian-generator normal rays against the inner Bezier section boundary; base fairing is not paired by a declared radial gap, and no solid classifier or all-face OCC query is used
finite_normal_ray_diagnostic.radial_gap_semantics: paired side control-pole radial gap is 2.5 mm before the shoulder-to-rim transition and increases to 3.5 mm at the rim; the outer base has no paired radial-gap definition; none of these values is normal thickness
finite_normal_ray_diagnostic.scope: finite 2D section-generator intersections only; a candidate inner-boundary distance, not a classifier-confirmed material interval or a global normal-wall minimum

algorithm_limits.scope: floating-point root search; diagnostic only; it does not classify a native solid or prove intersection absence between brackets

inner_base_fairing_exact_convexity_certi.regularity_proof: all radial-derivative Bernstein controls are strictly negative, so r'(t)<0 over the closed parameter interval and speed cannot vanish
inner_base_fairing_exact_convexity_certi.curvature_numerator_definition: r' z'' - z' r''; its sign equals signed curvature because speed cubed is positive
inner_base_fairing_exact_convexity_certi.scope: exact Bernstein sign and derivative-control certificates for this single section curve; sampled curvature remains finite-only and is not a whole-span radius bound
